title: Big Town Comic Festival
passage: If you love comic books, it's time to get animated. This year's Big Town Comic Festival will soon be here, and it's going to be bigger and better than ever. You'll get to see your favorite characters, meet your favorite artists and animators, and try out some of the latest and most popular video games. There will be rare comic books and toys for sale too, a chance for you to collect some of those hard-to-find toys. This year, we are excited to welcome special guests, Harold Merrill and Mary Anders. Harold made the Star Fight movies, and Mary is the award-winning writer of the Magic Pets Go comic books. Don't miss your chance to meet these two successful stars. Tickets go on sale on April 7th. That's a long time before the festival this summer, but you should get them early. They usually cost $100, but if you buy them before April 30th, they're half off. That's an amazing price for a weekend festival. So hurry, because we're expecting them to sell out fast.
